effect.name: GM Hue Shift Bands
effect.desc: Hue rotation applied in discrete bands. The layer's luminance, a rotatable position axis, distance from a point, angle around a point or time is cut into N bands, and each band gets its own hue offset - so instead of one flat rotation you get a stepped rainbow that follows the picture. Bands can also drive a saturation and a brightness wave, the edges can be feathered so the steps read as a soft posterise rather than a hard cut, and the whole stack can scroll over time. Layer space, so the bands stay welded to the layer.
